added_lines: facebook: loughgilly parish confessions : each saturday at 5.30pm saturday vigil mass: st malachy’s 6.00pm sunday morning mass: st brigid’s 10.00am st teresa’s @11.30am parish bulletin – sunday 18th oct 2026 our recently deceased: pat sexton, mickey mcguinness. loughgilly parish anniversaries: saturday 17th october – st. malachy’s 6pm john burke sunday 18th october – st. teresa’s 1 1.30am claire toner frank & lizzie feenan fr jim feenan margaret & frances hughes michael & rose crawley & dm saturday 24th october – st. malachy’s 6pm peter o’hare 1st anniversary michael finnegan mary canning & dm pat boyle margaret & brendan cushenan sunday 25th october – st. brigid’s 10am noelagh mcgivern tessie & eugene o’callaghan & dm sunday 25th october – st. teresa’s 11.30am dessie mckeown felix & susan mckeown edward ward parish collections 11th october - main collection - £2032.31 – 109 env mission sunday collection takes place this weekend as a second collection. ceremony of light please keep the children from our four schools in your prayers over the coming weeks and months. this saturday evening, the pupils preparing for confirmation will celebrate their ceremony of light . please respect graveyards we have received several serious concerns about dog fouling in belleeks graveyard. this is deeply upsetting and entirely unacceptable. the graveyard is a sacred place —a place of prayer, remembrance and respect for those who have died. the signs are clear: dogs are not permitted in the graveyard. please do not bring dogs onto the grounds, and if you see someone doing so, please remind them respectfully of the rule. mission sunday - we are truly grateful missio ireland thanks you for your prayers and financial support. the 2025 mission sunday collection raised €1,360,971 - a remarkable act of generosity in a time of financial challenge. prayer lies at the heart of all mission. communities facing hardship overseas, and the missionaries who serve them, draw great hope from knowing that people in ireland are praying for them. this week a second collection will take place to support the work of missionaries abroad, we ask you to give generously. november parish list of the dead as we approach the month of holy souls, we invite you to remember your deceased family members and friends. the parish list of the dead and envelopes are now available in each of our parish churches. please take a list, carefully write down the names of those you wish to remember, and return it with your mass offering before 1st november . you can drop the envelopes into the collection baskets, to the sacristy, parochial house or the parish office. all those named on these lists will be remembered in the mass, that will offered up on the first friday of each month in the coming year. i would encourage parishioners to join in this mass, in praying for all our deceased. may they rest in eternal peace. "it is a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead, that they may be released from their sins." 2 maccabees 12:46 whitecross (loughgilly)
